n1.speaker: Maite
n1.text: ¡Bienvenidos a IES Sarriguren! Soy Maite. Aquí damos clase en castellano y en euskera. Y una cosa: el portugués y el castellano se parecen, pero cuidado con los falsos amigos.
n1.translation: Welcome to IES Sarriguren! I'm Maite. We teach in Spanish and Basque here. And one thing: Portuguese and Spanish look alike, but beware of false friends.

late.text: Too late. You told Arantxa her stew was 'esquisito' last night. Best mistake you have made so far.

example.speaker: Maite
example.text: Por ejemplo: 'exquisito' no es raro. Es delicioso. Ya me lo agradecerás.
example.translation: For example: 'exquisito' isn't weird. It's delicious. You'll thank me later.

effects.log: Welcomed at IES Sarriguren by Maite, the Spanish teacher.

n1.speaker: Maite
n1.text: La clase de euskera está a la izquierda. No entenderás nada. Es normal.
n1.translation: Basque class is on the left. You won't understand a thing. That's normal.

n1.speaker: Iker
n1.text: ¡Eh, el portugués! Soy Iker. Clase de euskera gratis. Lección uno: 'egun on' = buenos días.
n1.translation: Hey, the Portuguese guy! I'm Iker. Free Basque class. Lesson one: 'egun on' = good morning.

end.speaker: Iker
end.text: ¡Eso es! Vuelve para la lección dos.
end.translation: That's it! Come back for lesson two.

n1.speaker: Iker
n1.text: Lección dos: 'eskerrik asko' = gracias. Dilo rápido cinco veces.
n1.translation: Lesson two: 'eskerrik asko' = thank you. Say it fast five times.

end.speaker: Iker
end.text: Casi. Eskerrik asko. Con la erre. Bueno, vale.
end.translation: Almost. Eskerrik asko. With the R. Fine, okay.

n1.speaker: Iker
n1.text: Lección tres: 'agur' = adiós. Lo necesitarás el sábado. No pienses en eso.
n1.translation: Lesson three: 'agur' = goodbye. You'll need it on Saturday. Don't think about that.

n1.speaker: Iker
n1.text: A ver, di algo en euskera. Lo que sea.
n1.translation: Go on, say something in Basque. Anything.

choices.text: "Egun on, eskerrik asko, agur!" (all of it, very fast)

laugh.speaker: Iker
laugh.text: ¡JAJAJA! 'Buenos días, gracias, adiós' en dos segundos. Eres una conversación entera.
laugh.translation: HAHAHA! 'Good morning, thank you, goodbye' in two seconds. You are an entire conversation.

effects.log: Made Iker laugh on purpose with three Basque words in a row.

n1.speaker: Iker
n1.text: Lección cuatro: 'bai' = sí. Fácil.

n1.speaker: Iker
n1.text: Lección cinco: 'ez' = no. Úsalo con los guisantes.
n1.translation: Lesson five: 'ez' = no. Use it on the peas.

n1.speaker: Iker
n1.text: Ya sabes más euskera que mi primo de Madrid.
n1.translation: You already know more Basque than my cousin from Madrid.

n1.text: Almuerzo: the mid-morning snack, a whole meal Portugal forgot to invent. On the counter: bocadillos de tortilla. And a tray of chickpeas.

chickpeas.text: You look at the chickpeas. The chickpeas look at you. Bocadillo it is.

effects.log: Had almuerzo at eleven: bocadillo de tortilla.

n1.text: Lunch at 14:00. Today: lentejas con chorizo, or garbanzos. Ana the vegetarian is negotiating with the cook.

eat.text: Lentils. Ana got a salad after a short treaty.

effects.log: Lunch at 14:00: lentils. Ana negotiated a salad.

n1.text: Closed. Almuerzo 10:30 to 11:30. Lunch 14:00 to 15:30. Your stomach is still on Portuguese time.

n1.speaker: Teacher
n1.text: Egun on denoi. Gaur energia berriztagarriei buruz hitz egingo dugu. Nafarroan haizea garrantzitsua da...
n1.translation: Good morning everyone. Today we'll talk about renewable energy. In Navarre, wind is important... Vinícius and the Portuguese group will help with the eco-house model on Friday.

n2.text: Forty minutes. You understood: 'Vinícius', 'Portugal', and one 'kaixo'. Inês, who dreaded reading Spanish, is taking notes. In Basque.

effects.log: Sat through a class in Basque. Understood three words.

n1.text: Empty desks. Someone drew the Osasuna crest on one, then an FC Porto crest next to it. Martim has been here.
Duarte is already shooting. Leonor sinks a three from the corner without looking. Two kids from IES Sarriguren are watching.

play.text: Nobody needs Spanish for a pick-and-roll. The two Spanish kids join in. Leonor wins at threes. Again.

effects.log: Played basketball at break with Duarte, Leonor and two kids from IES Sarriguren.

no.text: Leonor shrugs and sinks another one.

n1.text: You already played today. Your legs would like to lodge a complaint.

n1.speaker: Rafael
n1.text: Olha só. Horta escolar. Mostram-me terra e eu já estou em casa.

n2.speaker: Rafael
n2.text: Toma, agrião. Cresce em dois dias. Planta ali, naqueles canteiros. Eu trato da rega.

effects.log: Rafael gave you three packets of cress seeds for the eco-garden.

n1.speaker: Rafael
n1.text: Regar? Chove amanhã. É Navarra, chove sempre amanhã.

n1.speaker: Gonçalo
n1.text: Estoy muy embarazado por este viaje, ¿sabes?
n1.translation: I'm very pregnant about this trip, you know?

n2.text: Every Spanish student within ten metres turns around. Gonçalo has just announced that he is very pregnant.

choices.text: Say nothing. This is too good.

tell.speaker: Gonçalo
tell.text: ...Embarazada é grávida?! Eu disse isso ao professor Rui!

effects.log: Explained to Gonçalo that 'embarazado' means pregnant. He had said it to Professor Rui.

keep.text: You will tell him on Friday. Maybe.

effects.log: Let Gonçalo keep announcing he is pregnant. For science.

n1.speaker: Gonçalo
n1.text: Hoy he aprendido tres palabras. Todas mal, pero con confianza.
n1.translation: Today I learned three words. All wrong, but with confidence.

n1.speaker: Tiago
n1.text: Nunca dormi fora de casa. É estranho, não é? ...É estranho.

effects.log: Tiago has never slept away from home. Told him the first night is the worst one.

wed2.text: You do not know why Wednesday. It felt right.

effects.log: Told Tiago to hold on until Wednesday. No idea why.

n1.speaker: Tiago
n1.text: A minha mãe já mandou três mensagens. A tua?

n1.speaker: Duarte
n1.text: Os espanhóis são fixes, mas nós ficamos juntos, ok? ...Ok, o Iker é engraçado. Isso não conta.

no.speaker: Duarte
no.text: Basquete ao intervalo. Não te esqueças.

n1.speaker: Leonor
n1.text: Três pontos. Três de três. O cesto está ali, se quiseres perder.

n1.speaker: Unai
n1.text: Baloncesto es aburrido. Pelota vasca es mejor. Jajaja.
n1.translation: Basketball is boring. Basque pelota is better. Hahaha.

choices.text: "Then teach me pelota. I'll teach you a crossover."

effects.log: Made a deal with Unai: pelota lessons for basketball lessons.

n1.speaker: Unai
n1.text: Jajaja. ¿Has hablado con Iker? Habla mucho.
n1.translation: Hahaha. Have you talked to Iker? He talks a lot.
